mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate directly lowers the risk-free rate, compressing equity discount rates and increasing the present value of future cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate hiring, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >55% of triggered instances (UNRATE rise >0.5pp in 3 months), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a broad-based demand contraction, triggering recession fears that depress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline >0.5% in last month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >55% of joint decline instances, or Rank IC for joint signal falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 100.0 (2017=100) signals supply chain disruptions and manufacturing slowdown, increasing recession probability and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of triggered instances (INDPRO decline >1.0% in last month), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly real GDP growth (above 2.0%) indicates robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant monthly decline in non-farm payrolls (below 150k) signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate investment, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >55% of triggered instances (PAYEMS decline >50k in last month), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate hikes and disinflation (CPIAUCSL decline) signal aggressive monetary tightening without recession, increasing equity risk premiums and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises >0.25pp and CPIAUCSL declines >0.1pp in last month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of joint signal instances, or Rank IC for joint signal falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market slowdown (HOUST decline >1.0%) in an expansionary economic environment signals reduced consumer confidence and business investment, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of triggered instances (HOUST decline >1.0% in last month), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
